~ To: collection point %1 (infection confirmed by test)
## Progress display
· Shown on the terminal from a positive test-kit result.
## Medicines
· Infection delayer: progress halted while taken. Existing symptoms remain. A new wound ends the effect. No gain from stacking.
· Infection reverser: progress reset to the start. Nausea and endurance cap lifted. Infection remains; delayer still required.
· Cure serum: infection removed. No delayer needed after. Inject within the set period after issue.
## Infection handling fee
· From a wound until testing, and while positive: part of delivery credits withheld.
· Negative: nothing withheld. Waived from the first settlement after the cure.
· Reason: samples handled by the infected require disinfection and retesting by Team 2.
> ASHDOWN, MAJ.

· One point per assigned serum, credited once the body has adapted.
· Line serums: that line only. Shared enhancement serum: any line.

· Plan, then approve, in the Enhancement tab of the character info window.

· Points spent on a stage open the next.
· Items with a prerequisite: complete the prerequisite first.

· Credits required. Points refunded; meteorite fragments not.
